items.title: Payment slip generation API
items.description: A REST API for generating Brazilian payment slips (boletos), built with ASP.NET Core. The project explores API design, dependency injection, and containerized deployment using Docker.
details: Controller-based API exposing payment slip generation operations.
Layered structure separating endpoints, models, and repositories.
Docker configuration for packaging and running the application in a container.
